component.name: Paper Phone
component.summary: Compose today's information into a printable fold-up booklet
今日の情報を折り畳んで印刷できる冊子にまとめる

description.p: Paper Phone composes an offline booklet of your day: contacts, events, TODOs, weather and a walking map, printed as a foldable A4 sheet.
連絡先・予定・TODO・天気・歩行地図をA4の折り畳み冊子にまとめて印刷します。
